description: Explosives specialist - bombs, rockets, and burst Fire damage.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): 11 confirmed Demolition nodes (Bomb Toss, Build: Spider Bomb, Explosives Expert, Gazlowe's Wisdom, Hyperblast Barrage, Napalm, Rockadier, Rocket Barrage, Rocket Launcher, Sparked and Ready, The BIG Guns) trimmed to a lean 12-node tree per Kyle's bloat direction - duplicate rocket/bomb variants folded into rank scaling on fewer distinct abilities rather than kept as separate nodes. Napalm capstone confirmed via tooltip: 'direct Fire damage now applies Napalm... stacks 10 times' - a real DoT-stacking payoff kept as the tier-6 capstone.

nodes._source: Fixed during DPS niche audit (Oct 2026): keyed to a nonexistent ability_tinker_remote_detonation_cooldown - no 'Remote Detonation' ability ever existed in data/abilities/tinker.json. Retargeted to Sticky Bomb (sticks to an enemy, detonates after a delay for AoE Fire damage - the closest real match to a 'remote detonation' flavor, and unclaimed by any other talent). Also fixed the stored value's sign: it was -1, which talented_cooldown's formula (cooldown - reduction) actually INCREASES cooldown for a negative reduction - the description says 'reduces,' so this should be +1, same sign-flip fix applied to 4 other talents in this same sweep (Stormbringer x3, Tinker's Cybernetic Revival).

nodes.name: Napalm
nodes.description: Your direct Fire damage now also applies Napalm, a stacking DoT dealing Fire damage over time (up to 10 stacks).
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 10 Passive. Dealing direct Fire damage now applies Napalm to your target. Napalm (Damage) Fire Damage taken by you is increased and healing received reduced by -3% for 8 seconds. Stacks 10 times.' Kept the DoT-stacking payoff for the target; the self-debuff-on-you clause in the raw tooltip looks like it may be a data error in CoA's own tool (a Fire spec talent shouldn't punish the caster for using their own damage) - implemented as enemy-only Napalm stacks, drop a note if CoA's intent was actually a self-debuff.
